triple_arch_ritual_paragraph: An adhesive strip lifts ordinary wrist hair; a thermal printer advances one serrated line at a time; the road briefly becomes a civic artery whose gate can count passage but cannot own the blood; the singer rubs the square of pale skin beneath the strip. Paper rasp, idling fan, soft kick, and a clean late vowel leave the afterimage of an open door.
